scope: I01/N04/O09 existing-owner maintenance across internal sessions, visible system tasks, cancellation and minimum-start-TS diagnostics. No complete Go package acceptance.
contracts: Pooled internal sessions register by live entry identity, independent of possibly repeated connection IDs; dropping the session retires membership.
Scoped system tasks publish their actual process entry to process-list/info consumers. Idle internal sessions and all internal transactions remain excluded from the client/TIDB_TRX directory.
Restricted ANALYZE carries the live process capability instead of unit; the priority-queue production caller installs real Track/UnTrack callbacks.
Task ID collisions reject distinct entries; the same entry can be tracked again. Task identity is installed during SQL execution and restored even during unwinding.
Local KILL QUERY and KILL CONNECTION reach the actual physical ANALYZE killer; both interrupt a system task without closing the pooled session.
Track/UnTrack resets the current cancellation generation; a stale handle cannot reset a later command. System interruption and untracking serialize without locking the executing SQL session.

The leased timestamp reporter snapshots the internal directory before PD time, emits the shared long-running internal-session diagnostic and includes nonzero eligible timestamps. Active auto-analyze is excluded from the internal-directory leg; physical holds remain conservative.
removed: Visibility/cancellation disconnect between tracked tasks and their internal session

before.failure: restricted ANALYZE must hand the tracker its live session
before.method: Existing integration suite extended before production changes; original callback panic is caught by auto-analyze, and the outer tracked assertion fails.

intermediate.cause: Newly wired cancellation remained latched across a pooled-session reuse; repaired with Go Track/UnTrack reset semantics.
intermediate.review: Serialized system interruption/reset and made interruption evidence visible outside auto-analyze panic recovery.
